## reuse: approve

The supplied diff documents existing worker behavior as one coherent maintenance change. Its scope fits the approved infrastructure plan’s bounded repeat loop; runtime validation and CI were not independently verified.

The help text matches the enforced loop requirement and range. This documentation-only change introduces no generality or API-level issues; compilation and CI were not independently verified.

## placement: approve

The help text belongs beside the existing CLI option and matches the loop requirement and range checks. The supplied PR diff introduces no declarations or import changes requiring relocation.

## naming: approve

The help text accurately describes the existing --loop requirement and 1–20 bounds. No naming or notation issues were found; compilation and CI were not independently verified.

## documentation: approve

The help text accurately documents the --loop requirement enforced by worker_cli.py:186–187 and the inclusive 1–20 range enforced by worker_loop.py:14–15. No documentation issues found; CI was not independently verified.

The proposed help-text change contains no proofs and raises no proof-quality issues. No compilation or CI result was verified.

## correctness: approve

The theorem faithfully implies the approved roadmap target. The pinned Mathlib bound requires no integrability hypothesis, and the proof handles reversed and degenerate intervals correctly; compilation and CI were not independently verified.

## reuse: block

The new theorem directly specializes an existing Mathlib theorem and introduces a redundant public API. Compilation was not independently checked.

## scope: approve

The PR advances the approved Layer 8 unbounded-rectangle branch by proving its explicit uniform-decay target. The theorem, target-specialization example, and library export form one coherent topic; no absent earlier roadmap stage is required for this estimate.

## attribution: approve

The module identifies its roadmap target and credits the central Mathlib integral estimate by declaration name. The elementary uniform-decay argument shows no identifiable uncredited adaptation; compilation was not independently verified.

## api-design: approve

The public theorem supplies the roadmap application without compatibility aliases, exposed implementation bodies, or unnecessary helper declarations. No public API defect found; compilation was not independently verified.

## generality: request_changes

The proof is specialized to complex top edges despite using only a general uniform-decay estimate for interval integrals. Build status was not independently verified.
